headline: Focus AI traffic on /backtest pages to boost accounts, avoid zero-click news

findings.claim: AI reads many economic calendar and news pages but get zero clicks.
findings.so: Machines should point AI traffic away from these zero-click economic/news pages.

findings.claim: The /backtest page family has the highest AI accounts (48) and clicks (7.29) per 218 reads.
findings.so: Machines should direct AI traffic primarily to /backtest pages to maximize accounts.

findings.claim: AI clicks per week are stable at 39 but AI accounts dropped from 31 to 14 per week.
findings.so: Machines should focus on pages with higher account conversion to reverse AI account drop.

findings.claim: Direct source visitors convert better (63%) but lost 6.8 people in 14 days at land → account stage.
findings.so: Machines should optimize direct source landing pages to reduce leak and increase accounts.
